# Moodle CLI 0.13.1

This release publishes the Moodle client as a library, so your own Worker or Node code can read Moodle the same way the CLI does.

## Use moodle-cli from your own code

```ts
import { createMoodleClientCore, hasGrade } from "moodle-cli/core";

const moodle = createMoodleClientCore("https://moodle.example.edu", {
  cookie: { name: "MoodleSession", value: session },
});
const todo = await moodle.getTodo();
const grades = await moodle.getCourseGrades(courseId);
```

`moodle-cli/core` runs anywhere `fetch` does: Cloudflare Workers, Node and Bun. It carries its own types, and it has no CLI or file-system code. Pass the MoodleSession cookie and it resolves the sesskey and user itself. `getTodo()`, `getCourseGrades(id)`, `getAssignment(id)` and the rest return the same shapes the CLI prints as JSON, and `hasGrade()` tells a mark from an empty gradebook cell.
